profile.bio: I'm a full-stack developer focused on building modern, responsive and user-focused digital experiences. For over 4 years I've helped startups, agencies and product teams ship reliable web applications — from first wireframe to a smooth production launch. I care deeply about performance, accessibility and the details that make software feel effortless.
